design: tag-first people brain — folders only for Owner review workflow

panels.browse: Filter by tags (disposition, role, virtue) — not folder tree
panels.lookup: One file per person: entities/{id}.json — name, urls, claims, lie_profile
panels.review: review/ folder — bad-person candidates for ZacharyGeurts approval
panels.assess: Run lie-method stack on claim → update lie_profile on entity
panels.celebrities: Tag celebrity + respect level — H7 learns admiration not worship

review_workflow: 1. Entity tagged liar|terrorist|bad → copy to review/{id}.json
3. Owner: people approve <id> or people reject <id>
4. Approved → owner_approved tag; Rejected → flag removed, review file archived
disclaimer: People registry is Owner-curated intelligence — not public accusation, not legal verdict. Educational lie scoring only. Respect celebrities; do not harass. Bad tags require Owner review.
